definitions.explanation: A formal discussion or argument on a particular topic, especially one in which opposing views are put forward.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}{前|まえ}にテレビで{討論|とうろん}{会|かい}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A televised debate was held before the election.

examples.japanese: {死刑|しけい}{制度|せいど}について{討論|とうろん}する。
examples.english: To debate the death penalty system.

examples.japanese: {活発|かっぱつ}な{討論|とうろん}が{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {討論|とうろん}する (to debate)
- {討論|とうろん}{会|かい} (debate, discussion meeting)
- {討論|とうろん}を{行|おこな}う (to hold a debate)
- {活発|かっぱつ}な{討論|とうろん} (lively debate)

RELATED TERMS:
- {議論|ぎろん} - argument, discussion
- ディベート - debate (English loanword)
- {論争|ろんそう} - controversy, dispute
